explanations.9001: Nicodemus, a Pharisee, came to Jesus by night (John 3:1-2).
explanations.9002: Jesus said no one can see God's Kingdom unless born anew (John 3:3).
explanations.9003: The wind blows where it wants, so is everyone born of the Spirit (John 3:8).
explanations.9004: As Moses lifted up the serpent, so the Son of Man must be lifted up (John 3:14).
explanations.9005: John was baptizing at Aenon near Salim (John 3:23).
